g.text: Title: Shunt + range-switch adapter for INA228 module (nA - 2.5A)

g.desc: Title: Shunt + range-switch adapter for INA228 module (nA - 2.5A)

g.text: High-side, 3 shunts + P-FET range switching, Kelvin sense to external INA228 breakout

g.desc: High-side, 3 shunts + P-FET range switching, Kelvin sense to external INA228 breakout

g.text: Keep sense wires short and twisted. Calibrate each range with a known load; zero-calibrate range L with the DUT disconnected.

g.desc: Keep sense wires short and twisted. Calibrate each range with a known load; zero-calibrate range L with the DUT disconnected.

g.text: R4/R5 go to VIN upstream of the S+ tap. Logger: CTL_x HIGH = bypass FET ON (default at reset). VIN max ~6V (FET Vgs).

g.desc: R4/R5 go to VIN upstream of the S+ tap. Logger: CTL_x HIGH = bypass FET ON (default at reset). VIN max ~6V (FET Vgs).

g.text: J4 is a Kelvin sense output: S+ from the R1 pad, S- from the DUT terminal. No load current flows through the module.

g.desc: J4 is a Kelvin sense output: S+ from the R1 pad, S- from the DUT terminal. No load current flows through the module.

g.text: Shunt / range-switch adapter for an off-the-shelf INA228 breakout. Ranges: L = R1+R2+R3, M = R1+R2+Rds(Q2), H = R1+Rds(Q1).

g.desc: Shunt / range-switch adapter for an off-the-shelf INA228 breakout. Ranges: L = R1+R2+R3, M = R1+R2+Rds(Q2), H = R1+Rds(Q1).

g.text: Module prep: SparkFun SEN-31438 -> open the SHUNT jumper. Adafruit 5832 -> remove the 15 mOhm shunt. Tie module VBUS to S-.

g.desc: Module prep: SparkFun SEN-31438 -> open the SHUNT jumper. Adafruit 5832 -> remove the 15 mOhm shunt. Tie module VBUS to S-.
